scope: Conservative source-reviewed selections. Unmapped games remain under All. Mood describes play style, not a therapeutic or accessibility guarantee.

/luminahaven.reason: Decorating and gentle plant care, with adjustable weather, sound layers and reduced motion.

details.controls: Drag objects to arrange the room. Tap glowing forage to collect materials; use the plant and decor controls to care for and change your haven.
details.saves: The haven auto-saves on this device. The game can export and import a JSON layout.
details.accessibility: Reduced motion and calm presentation controls are available, alongside weather, lighting and sound choices.

/crownbadge.reason: Plan a watch, choose officers and decide how to handle incidents.

details.controls: Tap an officer, then an incident, or drag an officer onto a district. Keys 1–4 select officers; I selects the next call; Space advances the day.
details.saves: Continue a saved watch in this browser on this device.
details.accessibility: Reduced Stimulation stops the weather animation.

/offbrand.reason: Compare clues and use deduction while completing workshop jobs; also includes movement and quick tasks.

/touchline.reason: Plan transfers, training and match tactics.

/cyberpulse.reason: Dodge incoming fire and time phase parries while moving through the city.

/novasiege.reason: Aim, dash and survive waves of arena enemies.

/trailrunner.reason: Steer, climb and dodge hazards on a moving trail.

/apexrally.reason: React to an opponent and time racket shots.

/rallyvector3d.reason: Steer through rally stages and react to the road.
/rallyvector3d.review_note: Reviewed current source 20ef3a2daf6bfaf67b674d90c883cced91a81b56569198b080905607836f21b1 (approved SW2 contrast revision). Six procedural rally stages and steering/control instructions still support the Fast selection.

/hyperdraft.reason: Race, draft and time boosts to overtake.

/skybreak.reason: Pilot combat sorties, track targets and evade threats.

/apextennis.reason: Position quickly and time tennis shots.

/neonturf.reason: Drive, boost and contest the ball; Local Duel supports two players on one device.

details.controls: Player one uses W/S to drive, A/D to steer, Shift to boost and Space to pulse. Player two uses the arrow keys. Touch uses the floating stick and labelled BOOST and PULSE controls.
details.players: Two players share one keyboard or use two gamepads in Local Duel. A separate same-network mode requires manual pairing.

/apexkick.reason: Compare free kicks using manually paired devices on the same network.

details.players: Same-network multiplayer requires manual pairing between devices. Network play has been source-reviewed; connection success depends on the devices and network.
details.saves: Game progress and the Sports Passport stay in this browser unless you use the game’s export and import controls.

/auroralinks.reason: Two active golfers on two devices, with one remote peer on the same network.

details.controls: Drag across the course or use the left/right arrows to aim. Space controls the three-tap swing.
details.players: Two active players on two devices maximum, with one remote peer on the same network. Manual pairing is required; connection success depends on the devices and network.

/apexvelodrome.reason: Pass the same device between riders to compare ghost rides; no live network race.

details.controls: W/S or up/down adjust power; A/D or left/right change lane; Space sprints. On-screen controls provide the same core touch actions.
details.players: Pass the same device from rider A to rider B, or exchange ghost JSON files manually. Ghost comparison is asynchronous; there is no live LAN race.

/Lessons/Games/Neon_Garden.html.reason: Plant and cross-pollinate a garden without a clock or losing condition; ambient sound and calm presentation can be changed.

details.controls: Tap the ground to plant a seed. Drag to look around, pinch or scroll to zoom, and tap a plant to inspect it.
details.saves: The garden auto-saves in this browser on this device and grows while you are away.
details.accessibility: The title screen has Ambient sound and Calm presentation controls.

/Lessons/Games/Prism.html.reason: Place and rotate optical pieces to solve colour and light puzzles, without a timer.

details.controls: Pick a piece from the tray, then tap a cell to place it. Tap a placed piece to rotate it; use the remove mode to pick pieces back up.

/Lessons/Games/Lumins.html.reason: Plan and place bridges and other tools to guide moving Lumins to the exit; pause to consider the next intervention.

/Lessons/Games/WorldCup_ThreeLions_Final.reason: Teacher-led teams discuss and play a tournament on one shared display.

details.players: Teacher-led team play on one shared display. This is a group classroom game, not network multiplayer.
